summary: The demo app apps/ye-olde-magic-shop currently depends on file:./saturday-core, file:./saturday-cucumber and file:./saturday-playwright-heatmap — vendored copies of the framework that have drifted from packages/ (confirmed: the vendored saturday-cucumber config reads process.env.HEADLESS, the workspace package does not). This feature switches those three devDependencies to workspace:*, deletes the vendored directories and both app Dockerfiles that COPY them, moves the one confirmed behavior gap (HEADLESS default) into packages/saturday-cucumber with a new test, and regenerates pnpm-lock.yaml — so the app's golden Cucumber/Playwright suite exercises the real framework packages instead of a stale copy. A prior attempt already did this work on commit f372a30 (branch salvage/golden-workspace-packages) and parked only on a since-fixed cart.spec.ts bug (#7); the task is to re-apply that diff on top of current main, verify every test file it deletes already has a content-equivalent in packages/*/tests/**, resolve the two Dockerfiles (fix to build from the workspace, or remove with a recorded reason), and prove scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh now exits 0 where today it fails at collection for lack of a built dist/.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/package.json MUST declare @orieken/saturday-core, @orieken/saturday-cucumber and @orieken/saturday-playwright-heatmap as workspace:* dependencies, with no dependency in the file pointing at a path inside the app.
examples: Before: "@orieken/saturday-core": "file:./saturday-core" — After: "@orieken/saturday-core": "workspace:*" (matches the existing pattern already used for @orieken/saturday-playwright-k6-exporter and @orieken/saturday-playwright-leaflet in the same file)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The vendored directories apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/saturday-core/, saturday-cucumber/ and saturday-playwright-heatmap/ MUST be gone. Any test inside them that covers framework code and has no content-equivalent already under packages/ MUST move there instead of being deleted.
examples: By filename, all 13 vendored test files (e.g. tests/ml/coverage.spec.ts, saturday-cucumber/tests/world.spec.ts, saturday-playwright-heatmap/tests/tracker.spec.ts) already have a same-named file under packages/*/tests/** — content parity still needs byte-level confirmation before trusting the deletion, per the Open Questions below.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every Cucumber scenario and Playwright spec that passed before the change MUST still pass after it, with no .feature file or spec assertion changed. The before and after results MUST be recorded in the delivery record.
apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/Dockerfile and Dockerfile.runner, which both COPY the vendored directories, MUST each build from the workspace instead, or be removed with the reason recorded.
examples: Neither file is referenced by any GitHub Actions workflow, docker-compose file, or script in this repo — the only other Dockerfile.runner reference found (prototype-runner/local-cluster/run-local-k8s.sh) uses a generic $RUNNER_DIR unrelated to this app. Removal with that reason recorded is a valid reading of the criterion's 'or', matching what the salvaged commit already did.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Running scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh from the repository root on a fresh clone MUST exit 0, with its output recorded in the delivery record.
examples: The script's install_dependencies step already runs `pnpm --filter "@orieken/ye-olde-magic-shop^..." -r build` before the suite — once the three deps are workspace:* and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated, this step builds their dist/ and the collection failure described in the spec should clear without any script change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/golden-workspace-packages/.

proposedFitnessFunctions.property: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/package.json never re-introduces a file: dependency on a vendored framework copy
proposedFitnessFunctions.verification: judgment-only — code review checks devDependencies at review time; the spec's Infrastructure/Deploy Notes say None, so no new CI check is being wired this run (approval-gates.md #7 would gate that decision separately)

outOfScope: Renaming files, adding flows, or changing step definitions — explicitly deferred to later orders per the spec.

crossings: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop (consumer app) depends on packages/saturday-core, packages/saturday-cucumber, packages/saturday-playwright-heatmap (framework packages) — this feature makes that dependency a real workspace link instead of a drifted vendored copy.

Resolve any apply conflict against the #7 cart.spec.ts fix that landed after e9e4ae6 — reconcile manually rather than discarding either change.

If any spec fails through the script for a reason unrelated to the vendored packages (for example map.spec.ts needing network access to OpenStreetMap tiles), do not change the spec or the script — stop at the ship gate and name the spec and its cause in the delivery record.

No README, API doc, or ADR changes are expected from this change — state that explicitly in the delivery record rather than leaving it unaddressed.
devops: None required by this spec — Infrastructure / Deploy Notes state None, and no new CI wiring is requested. Confirm the regenerated pnpm-lock.yaml does not break any existing CI install step that pins to the prior lockfile hash.

edgeCases.case: git apply of the salvaged diff conflicts because main advanced past e9e4ae6 (notably the cart.spec.ts fix in #7)
edgeCases.handling: Reconcile manually, preserving both the cart.spec.ts import fix and the salvaged workspace/vendored-removal changes — do not discard either.

edgeCases.case: A vendored test file's content differs from its same-named packages/ counterpart in a way that adds real coverage the package lacks
edgeCases.handling: Per the spec's Open Questions, move that behavior into the package with a test, in this order, and name it in the delivery record — do not delete the vendored file first.

edgeCases.case: A golden spec fails through scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh for a reason unrelated to the vendored packages (e.g. the map page's OpenStreetMap tiles needing network access)
edgeCases.handling: Do not change the spec or the script; stop at the ship gate and name the spec and its cause in the delivery record, per the spec's own Open Questions resolution.

edgeCases.case: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/Dockerfile or Dockerfile.runner turn out to have an external CI consumer not visible in this repo
edgeCases.handling: If found, rewrite both to build from the workspace instead of removing them; if none is found by delivery time, default to removal with the reason recorded, matching the salvaged commit's choice.
